desc: A 2-in-1 weather resistant storage system to have blackpowder and primers at the ready whether in the field or at the shooting range. - The powder storage compartment holds plenty of loose blackpowder for multiple shots or reloads and is produced from a medical grade antistatic polymer. - The primer storage compartment holds 20 VariFlames or 209 primers. Plus is removable from the powder storage which can be taken into the field.
